channel.title: O Thank Heaven 4 711 -- Maui Travel Blog
channel.description: Maui travel guides from an oceanfront condo on the west shore.

item.title: Maui Ocean Center: Is It Worth It?
item.description: The Maui Ocean Center in Maalaea is a serious aquarium and cultural institution. What to expect, how long to allow, and who it is best suited for.

item.title: Scuba Diving in Maui: Best Dive Sites and Operators
item.description: Maui's dive sites include everything from Molokini's back wall to the Carthaginian wreck. Where to dive and which operators run the safest operations.

item.title: Best Beginner Hikes in Maui
item.description: From the Waihee Ridge Trail to the Kapalua Coastal Trail, the Maui hikes that reward effort without requiring technical skills or fitness you don't have yet.

item.title: Kamaole Beach Parks I, II, and III: Complete Guide
item.description: The three Kamaole beach parks are the heart of South Kihei's beach scene. What each one is best for, parking, and when to go.

item.title: Maui's Coral Reefs: What You Will See and How to Protect Them
item.description: Maui's reefs are home to hundreds of species but face real threats from warming water and sunscreen chemicals. What you will see and how to snorkel responsibly.

item.title: Maui Sunset Sail: Which Tour Is Worth Booking
item.description: A sunset sail in the AuAu Channel with Lanai on the horizon is one of Maui's signature experiences. The operators worth booking and what each one offers.

item.title: Best Coffee Shops in Kihei, Maui
item.description: The best coffee stops in Kihei from a morning ocean swim to a work session with an ocean view. Local roasters and reliable spots.

item.title: Whale Watching in Maui in January: Peak Season Guide
item.description: January is among the best months to watch humpbacks in the AuAu Channel. What to expect and how to make the most of whale season from a Kihei base.

item.title: Upcountry Maui Day Trip: Kula, Makawao, and Beyond
item.description: Upcountry Maui is a different island from the coast -- cooler, greener, and full of farms, art studios, and viewpoints that most visitors never reach.

item.title: Haleakala Without the Sunrise: Why the Afternoon Visit Is Underrated
item.description: The sunrise gets all the attention, but the afternoon and sunset at Haleakala are equally spectacular -- without the 3 a.m. wake-up or the sold-out reservations.

item.title: Makena State Park (Big Beach): A Complete Guide
item.description: Big Beach is one of Maui's most dramatic stretches of sand. What to know before you go -- shore break, parking, and the hidden Little Beach trail.

item.title: Stand-Up Paddleboarding in Maui: Best Spots and Rentals
item.description: South Maui's calm morning water makes it ideal for SUP. The best launch spots from Kihei, where to rent, and when to go.

item.title: Snorkeling at Molokini Crater: Complete Guide
item.description: Molokini is the most popular snorkel destination in Maui. What the experience is actually like, which operators are worth booking, and what to bring.

item.title: Best Coffee Shops in Maui
item.description: From Kihei plate lunch spots to upcountry roasters, Maui's coffee scene is worth exploring. The shops worth the detour.

item.title: Best Surf Lessons in Maui for Beginners
item.description: Where to take your first surf lesson in Maui, what the beginner breaks are like, and what a first session actually involves.

item.title: Whale Watching in Maui in February: What to Expect
item.description: February is peak humpback season in the AuAu Channel. What the activity looks like, where to watch from shore, and whether a boat tour is worth it.

item.title: Best Restaurants in Wailea, Maui
item.description: Wailea has some of the best dinner options in South Maui. The restaurants worth booking, what to order, and which ones to skip.

item.title: Kahului Airport (OGG): Tips for Arriving in Maui
item.description: What to do in the first two hours after landing at OGG -- car rental, grocery run, traffic timing, and the fastest route to South Maui.

item.title: Maui vs the Big Island: Which Hawaii Island Is Right for You?
item.description: The two most popular neighbor islands have different strengths. The comparison that actually helps you decide.

item.description: The best Maui snorkel spots for families with young children -- calm water, good visibility, and reef fish that kids actually want to see.
